load_structured_config: load a structured config from the ConfigStore by config path and return a ConfigResult
check_is_group: check if a config path corresponds to a GROUP type in the ConfigStore
check_is_config: check if a config path corresponds to a CONFIG type in the ConfigStore
list_structured_configs: list all structured configs under a given config path with optional type filtering
create_structured_config_source: create a StructuredConfigSource instance that imports a module and registers configs via ConfigStore
